title: Orange County Wedding Guitarist | Moses Lin Music
description: Moses Lin is an award-winning Orange County wedding guitarist who specializes in live music for ceremony, cocktail hour and reception. Moses performs regularly in OC at venues like Ritz Carlton Laguna Niguel and Pelican Hill Resort.
